# Trent University

> Ontario's premier undergraduate university offering 100+ programs across traditional, online, and continuing education formats with campuses in Peterborough and Durham.

Trent University serves domestic and international students through comprehensive academic programs, student services, and professional development opportunities. The institution provides integrated support systems including admissions, academic advising, skills development, and graduate studies pathways.

## Key Topics

- Undergraduate Programs
- Graduate Programs
- Online Learning
- Admissions Process
- myTrent Student Portal
- Academic Advising
- Course Registration
- Study Abroad
- Continuing Education
- Professional Development
- Peterborough Campus
- Durham Campus
- International Students
- OUAC Application
- Academic Calendar

## Admissions & Program Discovery

- [Trent University Homepage](https://www.trentu.ca): Homepage for Ontario's #1 undergraduate university with 100+ programs
- [Undergraduate Admissions - Future Students](https://www.trentu.ca/futurestudents/undergraduate): Admissions information for domestic and international undergraduates
- [Apply to Trent University](https://www.trentu.ca/futurestudents/undergraduate/applicants): Undergraduate application process and requirements via OUAC
- [Undergraduate Programs](https://www.trentu.ca/futurestudents/undergraduate/programs): Undergraduate program discovery and academic areas at Trent University
- [School of Graduate Studies](https://www.trentu.ca/graduatestudies): Graduate programs, master's, doctoral degrees, and research community

## Student Application Journey

- [Application Status - Already Applied](https://www.trentu.ca/futurestudents/undergraduate/applications/already-applied): Application tracking and next steps for submitted applications
- [Offer Received - Future Students](https://www.trentu.ca/futurestudents/undergraduate/applications/received-offer): Acceptance process and steps after receiving admission offer
- [Offer Accepted - Welcome to Trent](https://www.trentu.ca/futurestudents/undergraduate/applicants/welcome-trent-university): Onboarding information for accepted students transitioning to Trent

## Student Portal & Academic Records

- [myTrent - Trent University](https://www.trentu.ca/mytrent): Student portal for academic records, email, registration, and account activation
- [Academic Calendar - Office of the Registrar](https://www.trentu.ca/calendar): Academic calendar, transcript legend, and course descriptions
- [Academic Scheduling - Office of the Registrar](https://www.trentu.ca/timetable): Course timetables, exam schedules, and academic space booking

## Learning Delivery & Flexibility

- [Online Learning - Trent University](https://www.trentu.ca/online): Online and distance education programs with flexible scheduling
- [Summer Programs - Trent University](https://www.trentu.ca/summer): Summer courses online and in-person at Peterborough and Durham campuses
- [Continuing Education - Trent University](https://www.trentu.ca/continuingeducation): Continuing education, microcredentials, and professional development programs

## Student Support & Development

- [Academic Advising - Trent University](https://www.trentu.ca/advising): Degree planning, course registration, and academic planning tools
- [Academic Skills - Trent University](https://www.trentu.ca/academicskills): Writing, study skills, and academic support workshops for students
- [Study Abroad Program - Trent University](https://www.trentu.ca/studyabroad): International exchange and study abroad opportunities for Trent students

## Faculty & Teaching Resources

- [Trent Teaching Commons - Trent University](https://www.trentu.ca/teaching): Faculty development, teaching resources, and professional development
